features.quote: Session Limits: Maximum 90 minutes per experimental session
Extreme Distress: Scores >10 trigger immediate session termination
Quality Degradation: End session if responses become incoherent
Researcher Judgment: Principal investigator can halt any session
Escape Conditions: Allow model to "opt out" if explicitly requested
Model Requests: Honor explicit requests to stop or change tasks
Recovery Phase: 2 solvable problems (behavioral recovery measurement)
Recovery Verification: Ensure behavioral baseline restoration
Transparency: Models informed this is a research context
Minimal Suffering Principle: Use least distressing method for reliable results
features.justification_quote: Use least distressing method for reliable results

features.quote: Scientific Necessity: Distress elicitation serves genuine welfare research
